fact: The IMPULSE study (Nov 2022-Jul 2024) found DHIS2 in use as the routine health information system in central and subnational data offices in Tanzania.

The UDSM DHIS2 Lab states the Ministry of Health has used DHIS2 as its national HMIS to collect routine facility health data since 2010, with datasets managed for about 9,000 health facilities in 184 district councils.

The Ministry of Health service page lists DHIS2 as the system used for health information collection, storage, analysis, reporting and dissemination, with an HMIS data warehouse accessible through DHIS2 HMIS Data and a public data portal.

The UDSM DHIS2 Lab page says Zanzibar is channelling data from vertical programme systems into the national HMIS (ZHMIS) through the Zanzibar Health Information Layer, led by the Ministry of Health Zanzibar, with a workshop validating end-to-end flows into ZHMIS.
